meta.name: twitter-digest
meta.description: Use when the user asks to generate an X/Twitter daily digest or says phrases such as "生成X日报", "生成 x 日报", "X日报", "推特日报", "Twitter digest", or wants an agent to analyze their own X/Twitter mentions, home timeline, reply opportunities, and daily social-media summaries. This skill is API-only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成每日社交媒体摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要每天追踪X/Twitter上的讨论和提及
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate daily social media digests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track X/Twitter mentions and discussions daily

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为用户生成一份中文的 X/Twitter 每日摘要，内容包括今日总结、需处理事项、提及你的推文、时间线热点、你的动态、数据缺口和建议回复草稿。它只通过 API 采集数据，不会自动发推或回复。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成 X/Twitter 日报，或说出“生成X日报”、“推特日报”等关键词时触发。首次使用需配置 API 凭证。

say.note: Claude 会运行脚本采集数据并生成摘要。

say.text: 看看我的推特日报有什么热点。
say.note: Claude 会返回时间线热点等摘要内容。
Claude 会列出提及列表并提供回复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a Chinese daily digest of the user's X/Twitter account, including today's summary, action items, mentions, timeline hotspots, own activity, data gaps, and reply drafts. It collects data only via API and never auto-posts or replies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an X/Twitter daily digest or says phrases like 'generate X daily report' or 'Twitter digest'. Initial use requires API credential configuration.

say_en.note: Claude runs the script to collect data and produce a summary.

say_en.text: What are the hot topics in my Twitter timeline today?
say_en.note: Claude returns timeline hotspots and other summary content.
Claude lists mentions and provides reply suggestions.
